subject: Chief technical checkpoint & demo slot — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@olivetech.com>, Rob Patel <rob@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Chief technical checkpoint & demo slot — next steps

Hi Alice / Rob —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the right technical stakeholders aligned and unblock the pilot planning: 

Key takeaways from today's call:
- Primary use case: real-time ticket summarization + suggested responses for support agents (multi-tenant, per-customer context)
- Throughput target: ~500 requests/minute at peak; typical request size ~300 tokens
- Latency SLO: target p95 < 200ms for short responses; p99 requirements discussed for pilot
- Data & compliance: US-only residency for production; need a short summary of audit logs & retention for procurement
- Pilot goal: 8-week pilot to validate latency and costs; success metric = p95 <200ms + acceptable cost per 1M tokens

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Executive technical alignment: 30-minute handshake between OliveTech CTO (Rob), your product lead (Alice), and Redwood tech leads to confirm architecture, security constraints, and pilot runway.
2) Technical deep dive / demo: 45–60 minute session after the exec alignment to walk infra, model choices, and runbook.
3) I attached a short set of discovery notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and a draft Mutual Action List (MAL-Proposal-v1.docx) for planning—please take a look and flag anything missing.

If that sounds right, proposed windows for the 30-min CTO alignment:
- Tue, May 7 — 10:00–11:00 PT (we can do any 30-min slot in here)
- Wed, May 8 — 13:00–15:00 PT (we recommend 13:30–14:00 for minimal calendar churn)

Can you confirm Rob's availability for one of the windows above? If it's easier, feel free to send a calendar invite to soojin@redwood.com and marissa@redwood.com.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

Sooin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Thanks Soojin — great recap. Rob and I reviewed the notes and the plan looks reasonable. A couple quick items from our side before we lock time:

- Rob (CTO) asked for a 15–20 minute checklist describing the security/replication/data residency constraints you support (we primarily need to validate audit logs and key rotation options).
- Can you also provide a 1-page runbook we can share with our infra team ahead of the call?

Availability: Wed, May 8 works best for us. Rob is free 13:30–14:00 PT on the 8th — can we lock that? If you need a different time, Rob can also do Thu, May 9 09:00–10:00 PT.

If you prefer, go ahead and send a 30-min invite with the agenda and the runbook attached. We'll confirm internally once Rob accepts.
